Destroyed Omega ships can drop the Omega core that commanded them. Bigger ships drop it more often, the same way vanilla AI cores work: a destroyer counts twice, a cruiser three times and a capital four times.

If Astral Ascension is installed, it keeps control of Omega core drops and these two settings do nothing.

fieldDescription: Destroyed Omega ships can drop their Omega core. Switch off to make Omega cores unobtainable again.
Chance that a destroyed Omega frigate drops its core. Destroyers, cruisers and capitals multiply it by 2, 3 and 4.

defaultValue:
An Omega core installed in one of your colony buildings gives that building a powerful effect of its own. Buildings that make commodities make twice as much for half the demand, at double the upkeep. The building's tooltip says what its core does.

Covers the base game, Industrial Evolution, AoTD Vaults of Knowledge and Terraforming & Station Construction. Effects for a mod's buildings only exist while that mod is installed.

fieldDescription: Omega cores give colony buildings their special effects. Switch off to go back to the plain upkeep discount. The fix for the Industrial Evolution Supercomputer crash stays on either way.
How much faster time runs, in percent, for a ship captained by one of your Omega cores. 0 switches the perk off. Enemy Omega ships never get it.
